notablePrerequisites:
Tablet of Compleation has at least five oil counters on it.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Tablet of Compleation's third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Tablet of Compleation and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
